high_level_description: This image depicts the entrance of a white building with classical architectural features. The building has a symmetrical design with a central entrance flanked by two arched windows on either side. Each window is adorned with intricate metalwork, adding an elegant touch to the facade. Above the windows, there are decorative elements that enhance the building's grandeur. The entrance is approached by a set of wide, light-colored stone steps leading up to a small platform.
